title: One Year — A Listener's Story
gist_ar: قصة طارق: كان خايف يغيّر شغله، فغيّر خطة مذاكرته وبقى أسعد بعد سنة.

before_listening.en: The last story of the week. Listen for WHAT Tarek changed, and what happened after.
before_listening.ar: آخر قصة في الأسبوع. ركّز على طارق غيّر إيه، وإيه اللي حصل بعدها.

segments.speaker: Presenter
segments.text: Our last story this week comes from Tarek in Tanta. Tarek wrote to us a year ago, because he wanted to change his job but he was afraid. He was working in his uncle's shop, and although the money was enough, he was bored. So he decided to study in the evening. First he studied for two hours after work, but he was too tired, so he changed his plan. He started waking up at five and studying before work instead. It was hard at the beginning, but after three months it became normal. Then, in March, he applied for a job in a small company in Tanta, and he got it. He earns a little less than before; however, he says he is much happier, because he is learning something new every week. Tarek, thank you for writing. And if you are waiting for the perfect moment, it is probably going to be a Tuesday morning at five.

gist_question.q: What did Tarek change, and what was the result?
options: He moved to another city, and he earns more now
He studied before work instead of after it, and he got a new job
He stopped studying, and he stayed in his uncle's shop

questions.q: Why was Tarek bored in his uncle's shop?
questions.q_ar: ليه طارق كان زهقان في دكان عمه؟
options: The money was enough, but the work was boring

questions.q: Why did he stop studying after work?
What does Tarek say about his new job?
options: He earns more and is happier
He earns a little less but is much happier
He earns the same but works less
